Messages.Author: Nicx
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I would like to know... Smiling Jack, The Anarch say:

- Methuselah during his or her untap phase burns 1 pool or burns 1
blood from a vampire he or she controls for each blood on Jack.

What if the Mathuselah as only one blood on each of is vampires and
there are 3 blood on Smiling Jack? Can he pay one only one blood from
each of his vampires (for a total of three) or he have to pay three
pool?

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Nicx <ns...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> Hi,





For each counter on Jack, you get to decide whether to burn one pool or
one blood off of a vampire. It doesn't have to be the same vampire.
So, yes, you can pay one blood from each of your three vampires.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Sure. Mix-n-match blood (from any number of vampires) and pool.
